bear_assumptions: Twelve-month book value reaches about USD 9.00 but credit costs rise, personal-loan growth slows, Technology Platform weakness persists and the multiple compresses to 1.25x.
base_assumptions: Book value reaches about USD 9.50 as member, deposit and fee growth sustain profitability; normalized credit remains manageable and a 2.2x multiple reflects strong growth with developing through-cycle returns.
bull_assumptions: Book value reaches about USD 10.00 as cross-buy, financial-services scale and Technology Platform stabilization drive durable return-on-equity expansion; stable credit supports a 3.2x multiple.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only when current primary evidence, a fresh mark and an accepted causal relationship clear confidence-adjusted expected-return, base-upside, bear/base and expected/bear payoff, margin-of-safety and confidence gates; downgrade on materially weaker credit, funding, regulatory capital, per-share book-value growth, Technology Platform economics or dilution.
